articles.title: Global Wellness Network Havas Health Expands to 254K SF at 200 Madison Avenue
articles.narrative: Havas Health, a global health and wellness communications network, has expanded its Midtown headquarters at 200 Madison Avenue in a 15-year lease deal. The company renewed its existing 189,461 square feet and added an additional 64,657 square feet, bringing its total footprint to 254,118 square feet across five floors. The landlord noted that Havas Health's long-term commitment reflects the appeal of the building's hospitality-focused and amenity-rich environment.

data_points.address: 200 Madison Avenue, New York City, NY
data_points.notable_features: 26-story office building located seven blocks south of Grand Central Terminal. Building features a recently renovated entrance and lobby, and a new 11,000-square-foot indoor-outdoor amenity center on the 10th floor with conference rooms, a game area, lounge, event spaces, and an outdoor garden.
data_points.project_notes: Havas has been a tenant at the building since the late 1990s. The lease extends through at least 2041.

articles.title: T30 Capital Sells East Williamsburg Loft Building at 59 Bogart Street for $30M
articles.narrative: Local real estate investor Jo-Ann Obergfell, operating through 59 Bogart LLC, has acquired a 51-unit multifamily loft building at 59 Bogart Street in East Williamsburg, Brooklyn, from T30 Capital for $30 million. The property, originally an industrial building converted to residential lofts in 2005, attracted significant investor interest due to its transit-oriented location and value-add potential. The seller's broker noted strong demand for the asset, reflecting continued capital seeking opportunities in active investment markets.

data_points.notable_features: Three-story building with one- to three-bedroom units, a lounge, gym, bike room, and communal outdoor spaces, located above the L train's Morgan Avenue station.
data_points.project_notes: The property was converted from industrial to residential lofts in 2005. T30 Capital's predecessor entity, Sugar Hill Capital Partners, previously acquired the property for $39.5 million in 2016.

articles.title: Savills Inks 20K-SF Deal at Rudin’s 560 Lexington Avenue
articles.narrative: Savills, a global real estate advisory firm, has expanded its New York City footprint by leasing 20,481 square feet at Rudin's 560 Lexington Avenue. The firm will occupy the entire third floor of the Midtown East tower for a five-year term, accommodating its program and project management group. This expansion follows Savills' recent acquisition and launch of Eastdil Secured Savills, signaling a strategic growth in its platform.

data_points.address: 560 Lexington Avenue, New York City, NY
data_points.notable_features: Located at the corner of East 50th Street and Lexington Avenue, three blocks east of Rockefeller Center.

articles.market_intelligence: The average asking rent for Midtown office space was $84.88 per square foot in July. 560 Lexington Avenue has completed over 110,000 square feet of deals this year.

articles.title: Vivmark Residential Acquires California Multifamily Portfolio for $742M
articles.narrative: Vivmark Residential, the newly formed entity from the merger of AvalonBay Communities and Equity Residential, has acquired a portfolio of seven multifamily properties in Northern California for a total of $741.8 million. The acquisition comprises over 1,800 units across several transactions, reinforcing the firm's strategy to expand its coastal market presence. This move follows the recent $71 billion merger, which created the largest apartment REIT in the industry.

data_points.project_notes: The acquisition consists of seven separate transactions totaling $741.8 million, following the $71 billion merger of AvalonBay Communities and Equity Residential.

Concord Summit Capital Arranges $28M in Financing for Metro Houston Mixed-Use Project
articles.narrative: Concord Summit Capital has arranged $28 million in nonrecourse financing for The Albritton, a mixed-use development currently under construction in Friendswood, a suburb of Houston. The project, being developed by Tannos Development Group, will feature 111 apartments, retail, office space, and a parking garage. Completion is anticipated in 2028.

data_points.notable_features: Includes 11,000 square feet of retail, 9,000 square feet of office, and a 72,000-square-foot parking garage.

articles.title: JVM Realty Buys 280-Unit Apartment Community in Oswego, Illinois
articles.narrative: JVM Realty Corp. has acquired Springs at Oswego, a 280-unit apartment community in Oswego, Illinois, which has been rebranded as Trillium at Oswego. The property, featuring townhome-style units and a range of amenities, was sold by Continental Properties. Cushman & Wakefield facilitated the transaction.

data_points.notable_features: Gated community with townhome-style units, heated pool, 24-hour fitness center, clubhouse, outdoor grilling stations, fire pit, car wash, and two dog parks.

articles.title: Merritt Properties Breaks Ground on 150-Acre Industrial Park Near Raleigh-Durham Airport
articles.narrative: Merritt Properties has commenced construction on the initial phase of RDU Business Park, a substantial 150-acre light industrial development in Morrisville, NC, strategically located near Raleigh-Durham International Airport. The first phase, encompassing 31 acres, will deliver three single-story buildings totaling 201,250 square feet by late 2027. Upon full build-out, the park is slated to feature 13 buildings across 790,527 square feet, offering modern industrial specifications designed to attract a diverse tenant base.

data_points.notable_features: Buildings will include 18- or 24-foot clear heights, rear-loading docks, drive-in capabilities, 30- and 40-foot column spacing, and surface parking. Two buildings will share a 150-foot truck court, while the third will feature a dedicated 110-foot truck court.
data_points.project_notes: The project is situated within the jurisdiction of the city of Cary, NC.

articles.title: Agemark Acquires, Rebrands Seniors Housing Community in Omaha
articles.narrative: Agemark Senior Living, in partnership with an undisclosed investment partner, has acquired Esprit Whispering Ridge, an assisted living and memory care community in Omaha, NE. The property has been rebranded as The Bellflower at Whispering Ridge, and the new owners plan to invest approximately $1.3 million in capital improvements. The community will expand its offerings to include independent living and "assisted living plus" units, bringing Agemark's Omaha portfolio to five communities with over 450 units.

data_points.property_name: The Bellflower at Whispering Ridge (formerly Esprit Whispering Ridge)
data_points.notable_features: Assisted living and memory care community, to be expanded with independent living and 'assisted living plus' units.
data_points.project_notes: Agemark Senior Living acquired the property with an undisclosed investment partner. The stated total project cost refers to planned capital improvements.

articles.title: Cross Street, Mavrek Begin Leasing 46-Unit Apartment Building in Chicago
articles.narrative: Cross Street and Mavrek have commenced leasing for Belmora, a 46-unit apartment building in Chicago's Lakeview neighborhood. The property also features ground-floor retail space. A second, identical building is slated for completion later this year, adding another 46 apartments and retail space to the development.

data_points.notable_features: Includes 5,700 square feet of ground-floor retail space; amenities include a fitness center, coworking space, package room, bicycle storage, and a furnished lobby lounge.
data_points.project_notes: A second building at 917 W. Belmont Ave. will be completed later in 2026, adding 46 apartments and 5,300 square feet of ground-floor retail.

articles.title: The NRP Group breaks ground on 150-unit affordable-housing community in Columbus
articles.narrative: The NRP Group has broken ground on Stone Ridge at High Street, a 150-unit affordable housing community in Columbus, OH. Developed in partnership with the City of Columbus and the Ohio Housing Finance Agency, the project will provide housing for working professionals and families earning up to 60% of the Area Median Income. The community is scheduled for completion in April 2028.

data_points.notable_features: Located approximately one mile from downtown Columbus with ample public transit access and proximity to shopping, dining, job centers, and major employers.
data_points.project_notes: Developed in partnership with the City of Columbus and the Ohio Housing Finance Agency to provide housing for families earning up to 60% of the Area Median Income.

articles.title: Summit RE brokers sale of retail center in Lewisville
articles.narrative: Summit RE has brokered the sale of Sojourn Retail, a 7,871-square-foot retail condominium interest in Lewisville, TX. The property, located on Windhaven Parkway, was sold by a developer to a local Dallas-Fort Worth buyer. The transaction highlights the continued demand for retail assets in areas with strong demographics and traffic counts.
articles.market_intelligence: The property is located in an area with over 247,469 people within a 5-mile radius and an average household income exceeding $131,808. Windhaven Pkwy sees over 13,332 vehicles per day.

articles.title: CBRE adds associate to St. Louis office
articles.narrative: Michael Yemm has joined CBRE's St. Louis office as an associate, where he will focus on industrial property leasing. He will collaborate with Katie Haywood, Brian Bush, and Jon Hinds, leveraging his background in finance, marketing, management, data science, and economics.

articles.title: Trademark Acquires 116K-SF Austin Shopping Center
articles.narrative: Trademark Property Company, in partnership with Cohen & Steers, has acquired Oak Hill Plaza, a 116,000-square-foot neighborhood shopping center in Austin, TX, from Partners Capital. Trademark will oversee property management, leasing, and a planned upgrade to enhance the tenant mix and modernize the center. The acquisition is strategically timed with the near completion of the $674 million Oak Hill Parkway Project, which is expected to significantly improve accessibility to the property.

data_points.notable_features: Located at the northwest corner of US 290 and SH 71, benefiting from the recently completed $674 million Oak Hill Parkway Project.

articles.title: Bourn Cos. Acquires Oro Valley’s Innovation Park for $21.2M
articles.narrative: Bourn Cos. has acquired Innovation Park, a 333-acre master-planned business park in Oro Valley, from Venture West Group for $21.2 million. The transaction involved approximately 30 parcels within the business park, which is home to a strong tenant mix. Bourn Cos. plans to transform the property into a mixed-use business park, aiming to attract major employers and provide modern amenities for the workforce.

articles.title: Work Begins on 60-Unit Denver Supportive Housing Community
articles.narrative: Brothers Redevelopment, Inc. has commenced construction on Wagoner on the Creek, a 60-unit permanent supportive housing community in Aurora, CO. The nearly $31 million development will cater to justice-involved and unhoused residents in Arapahoe County, requiring future occupants to earn less than 60% of the area median income. The project is supported by a diverse capital stack, including contributions from seven government agencies, two banks, and Low-Income Housing Tax Credits, and will offer comprehensive on-site support services.

data_points.notable_features: Outdoor amenity area with grills, shrubbery, fountains, and walking trails.
data_points.project_notes: Serves justice-involved and unhoused residents earning less than 60% of area median income. On-site services include case management, behavioral health counseling, peer navigation, employment support, and medical services.

articles.financing: 10 funding sources, including seven government agencies, two banks, and a LIHTC contribution.

articles.title: Velocity Financial to Acquire Toorak Operating Platform, Manage $3B Loan Portfolio
articles.narrative: Velocity Financial, Inc. has agreed to acquire the operating platform of Toorak Capital LLC, a lending and asset management platform for single-family and multifamily properties. Concurrently, a third-party investment firm will acquire Toorak's existing $3 billion loan portfolio. Velocity will manage this portfolio and also handle future loan production for the third-party firm and other counterparties, expanding its market presence and operational capabilities.

data_points.project_notes: The total value of the platform and portfolio transactions is estimated at approximately $3.2 billion based on Toorak’s consolidated balance sheet as of June 30. Toorak will maintain its existing brands and management team, and retain its corporate headquarters in Tampa.

articles.title: Pinal County Rejects Controversial Data Center Project
articles.narrative: Pinal County officials have rejected a rezoning request for the proposed La Osa data center, effectively blocking the project. The decision came amidst significant local opposition to the development.

data_points.address: 1891 Pinal County Courthouse, 135 N Pinal St, Florence, AZ

articles.title: Harworth Rebuffs Peel After £583M Bidder Criticises Strategy And Returns
articles.narrative: Harworth has rejected a £583 million takeover bid from Peel, stating that the offer significantly undervalues the company. Harworth's board believes its current strategy and future plans will deliver greater returns for shareholders than the proposed acquisition price.

articles.title: EQT Real Estate Sells 10M SF Southeast Logistics Portfolio
articles.narrative: EQT Real Estate has sold a substantial 10 million-square-foot logistics portfolio, comprising 46 buildings across the Southeast region, to LBA Realty. This transaction highlights continued strong investor demand for industrial and logistics assets in key Southern markets.

articles.title: Ethics Disclosure Shows Trump Sold CoStar, Bought CoreWeave Stock In June
articles.narrative: Former President Trump's financial disclosure for June indicates a significant volume of trades, positioning him as a net seller of commercial real estate firms. Among the notable transactions, he divested shares in CoStar and acquired stock in CoreWeave.

articles.title: Cold Storage Facilities See Record Vacancy, Flight To Newer Properties
articles.narrative: The cold storage warehouse market is experiencing record vacancy rates, totaling 56 million cubic feet of vacant space. This trend is particularly impacting older facilities, as occupiers are increasingly opting for newer, more efficient properties.
